entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: The sphinx guildmaster of the Azorius Senate on Ravnica, petrified by Vraska.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild devoted to law, led by Isperia.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Isperia led the Azorius.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose members Isperia ordered arrested.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: Planeswalker arrested under Isperia's writ and later Bolas' minion who petrified Isperia.

entities.name: Duskend Troubles
entities.description: A prison riot in an Azorius detention compound in which nearly one hundred were killed.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder dragon planeswalker whose manipulations victimized Isperia.

entities.name: Undercity
entities.description: Ravnica's undercity, where Isperia's petrified form sank.

events.summary: As a judge, Isperia issued a writ of mass arrest of Golgari members, and Vraska was apprehended.
The overcrowded Azorius detention compound fell to a prison riot, the Duskend Troubles.
events.quote: These events became known as the Duskend Troubles

events.summary: Isperia replaced Augustin IV as guildmaster after years of convincing.
events.quote: Isperia was the guild champion before she replaced Augustin IV

events.summary: Vraska petrified Isperia after the first day of the guild summit; Dovin Baan replaced her.
events.quote: She was petrified by Bolas' minion Vraska after the first day of the guild summit

events.summary: Isperia's petrified form sank into the Undercity and began to be reclaimed.
events.quote: Isperia's petrified form sank into the Undercity
